verdict.rationale: Cekura is a SaaS testing and observability platform that stores call logs, so data residency is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions choosing a storage region or residency location. PII redaction (cekura-docs-12, cekura-docs-60) is an adjacent privacy control and does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
